prompt: Thiol-type nucleophile opens epoxide: cyclohexene oxide + NaSEt (sodium ethanethiolate). Draw the trans product.
explanation: Thiolate (RS⁻) is a soft, strong Nu. SN2 backside attack on the epoxide C gives a trans product (new OH and new SR on opposite faces of the ring). Thiolates attack epoxides very cleanly — much faster than alkoxides.
